# vengtoo_group_membership (Resource)

Adds a subject to a group. Deleting this resource removes the subject from the group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_id` (String) Subject to add.
- `group_id` (String) Group to add the subject to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: group_id:entity_id
